data.title: Vacation Planning Request (Urlaubsplanung) for Jan–June 2027
data.case_title: Employer letter: vacation planning & contract debit notice
data.summary: Druckerei Beispiellahn GmbH's HR department asks Johanna Beispielacker to submit her vacation preferences for January to June 2027 within 10 working days of the letter date (18 November 2026), and notes that the usual monthly direct debit for her separate contract AG-4756-748 will be collected on 4 December 2026.
data.explanation: Your employer wants everyone to register vacation wishes for the first half of 2027 early so shifts can be planned. Enter your preferences in the list in the break room or in the employee portal by the deadline shown in the app (10 working days from the letter date). No consequence for missing it is stated in the letter, but it is best to submit on time so your preferences are considered. Separately, the letter reminds you that the usual monthly amount for your other contract (AG-4756-748) will be debited automatically on 4 December 2026 — you don't need to do anything for that.

items.title: Submit vacation preferences for January–June 2027
items.action: Enter your vacation wishes for the first half of 2027 into the list in the break room or the employee portal.
items.quote: Ihre Wünsche für den Urlaub im ersten Halbjahr tragen Sie bitte binnen 10 Arbeitstagen ab dem Briefdatum in die Liste ein; Arbeitstage sind Montag bis Freitag ohne Feiertage.

items.title: Monthly direct debit for contract AG-4756-748
items.action: No action needed; the amount is collected automatically by direct debit (Lastschrift) from your account.
items.quote: Der monatliche Beitrag für Ihren separaten Vertrag AG-4756-748 wird wie gewohnt am 04.12.2026 per Lastschrift von Ihrem Konto eingezogen; Sie brauchen dafür nichts zu veranlassen.
